title: HumanApprovalReceipt.v1
description: A recorded human approval for a BOUNDARY-EXPANDING change before it is promoted (the capstone rule: humans approve boundary expansion). The parallel-path engine's automated gates decide apples-to-apples correctness/cost; this gate is required ON TOP when a change widens what a capability is allowed to do (new capability/tool/runtime-class/data-class/autonomy/external provider). A non-boundary-expanding promotion does NOT require this.

subject_ref.description: the promotion decision_id / capability the expansion applies to
